scope: Identical completed-Energy split-K choices copied independently into every S4 worker; original/frozen/run-local hashes must remain unchanged. M1/M16 use bucket16; M128 uses bucket128. Triton tile autotuning is not frozen; selected tiles are captured per case.
fixed_batch_distinction: S1 uses independent empty run-local split-K caches and includes split-K autotuning variability. S4 fixes split-K only; process-local tile autotuning remains active. S4 and S1 are not a causal runtime decomposition.
